turnaround_reason: Perrigo was obliterated over 2022-2026 as a failed $1.5B Opill OTC contraceptive launch combined with infant formula exit, goodwill impairments, and an $3.83B debt load sent the stock from $40+ to near $9. The company is now executing a 'Three-S' restructuring plan, divesting non-core assets (Dermacosmetics sold for ~€306M, proceeds to debt), and focusing on its U.S. Store Brand OTC and Specialty Care segments — which are both gaining share.
bullish_points: Q1 2026 adj EPS of $0.43 beat $0.31 estimate by 40%; Q2 2026 estimate is only $0.36 — lowball bar heading into July 31 earnings
27.3% short float + 5.61 short ratio = enormous squeeze potential on any positive surprise
All analyst targets ($14-$20 range, mean $16.50) are 33-90% above current $10.54 price — significant re-rating implied by consensus
Forward PE of 4.46x is extraordinarily cheap if adj earnings power of ~$1.50-$1.80/year materializes
Dermacosmetics divestiture (~€306M) directly reduces the crushing debt load
Specialty Care (Compeed, Opill, ellaOne) showing organic growth and improving margins
Q2 2026 earnings July 31 — imminent catalyst with beaten Q1 bar building momentum
Price/book 0.58x — stock trading below book value
Operating cash flow $189M TTM despite GAAP losses — real cash-generating business
bearish_points: Debt ($3.83B) is 2.6x market cap — equity is effectively a subordinated call option on the business; any operational stumble could trigger covenant issues
Core organic revenue declining -11% in Q1 — the underlying business is shrinking, not growing
Adj gross margin down 340bps YoY (37.6% → adj basis) — volume declines not offset by cost cuts
Goodwill impairment ($~390M hit in Q1 implied by reported EPS of -$2.81) signals prior acquisition values are permanently impaired
Revenue guidance maintained but explicitly caveated for 'geopolitical developments in the Middle East and retailer inventory destocking' — known risk factors
Reported ATM IV of 6.25% on Nov expiry seems like a data anomaly — actual IV likely much higher near earnings; options pricing unclear
27% short interest reflects genuine institutional concern about the debt load and organic revenue trend
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings on July 31 — beat + guidance raise (or any debt-reduction milestone announcement) could trigger violent short squeeze given 27.3% short float
suggested_trade: Small spot position ($10.50-$11.00 entry) sized at 50% of normal given debt risk. The earnings-short-squeeze setup is real but the debt load keeps this a spec play. Do NOT use options until IV is independently verified (6.25% ATM IV data appears unreliable).
key_risk: Q2 organic revenue decline accelerates or management cuts FY2026 guidance — with 27% short interest the stock could gap to single digits on a miss; debt at 2.6x market cap creates asymmetric downside if the thesis breaks
would_skip_if: Q2 results show adj EPS miss, guidance cut, or any indication Dermacosmetics proceeds are delayed/smaller than expected; also skip if stock gaps up >15% before earnings
